description.value: The Bubble Tea Shop is a local small business with locations in Richmond and Vancouver's Olympic Village, specializing in bubble tea and DIY milk tea kits. The Richmond storefront offers in-store pickup of ready-made drinks and retail supplies including loose leaf teas, flavoured powders, and toppings. It is a community-oriented café-style shop that also ships its DIY kits across Canada.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the Richmond location at #105 - 4651 No. 3 Road, matching OSM address and unit tags. The site primarily showcases DIY bubble tea kit products for online order with in-store pickup, with no mention of bike parking, washrooms, or water refill. The 'Update 04/07/23' delivery notice and residual 'unprecedented times' language suggest the website has not been updated recently, though the business appears to still be operating.
concerns: Website contains 'unprecedented times' language and delivery policy dated 04/07/23, suggesting the site has not been updated in over two years.
No phone number available in OSM or on the website.
Business model appears to be primarily retail/DIY kit sales with pickup rather than a traditional sit-in café; in-store beverage service is not explicitly confirmed on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The business is a legitimate food & drink stop but operates primarily as a DIY kit retail and pickup shop. None of the key WWC cycling amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill) are confirmed, and the website content is dated, making it insufficient to assess cyclist-friendliness.
enrichment_extras.notes: Email contact is thebbtshop@gmail.com as listed on the website. A second location exists at 1764 Manitoba Street, Vancouver, BC V5Y 0H1 (Olympic Village) — this OSM record covers only the Richmond unit.

wow_evidence: local small business with locations in Richmond and Vancouver's Olympic Village
